questions.question: John the Baptist sent two of his disciples to Jesus with a question. What did John want to know?

answers.text: If Jesus is the One who was to come
If Jesus will come and baptize with him
If Jesus will teach them how to pray

questions.question: When John the Baptist's disciples came to Jesus with John's question, what did Jesus tell them to report back to John?

answers.text: What they had seen and heard
That John should come and see
That they must wait for a sign

questions.question: When John the Baptist's disciples asked if Jesus was the One who was to come, whom did Jesus say is blessed?

answers.text: The one who does not fall away because of Him
The one who has seen His miracles up close
The one who keeps every word of the law

questions.question: Jesus said that even the least in the kingdom of God is not as great as John the Baptist. True or false?
